title: NATS Streaming (`stan`) trigger type is removed

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: NATS Streaming scaler: Remove NATS Streaming Server (aka Stan) (#6366)
remediation: pkg/scaling/scalers_builder.go at v2.19.0 has no `case "stan"` any more: every ScaledObject / ScaledJob named fails to build its scalers after the hop and stops scaling. Migrate the trigger to `nats-jetstream` before upgrading.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select(.type == "stan") | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row stops scaling on the hop
